easy.question: Add Two Numbers
easy.description: Given two integers a and b, return their sum.
easy.hint: Use the + operator to add two numbers.

easy.question: Check Even or Odd
easy.description: Given an integer n, return True if it is even, else return False.
easy.hint: A number is even if n % 2 == 0.

easy.question: Maximum of Two Numbers
easy.description: Given two integers a and b, return the larger one.
easy.hint: Use an if-else or the built-in max() function.

easy.question: Absolute Value
easy.description: Given a number n, return its absolute value (without using abs()).
easy.hint: If n < 0, return -n, else return n.

easy.question: String Length
easy.description: Given a string s, return the number of characters in it.

medium.question: Reverse a String
medium.description: Given a string s, return a new string with characters in reverse order.

medium.question: FizzBuzz
medium.description: Given a positive integer n, return 'Fizz' if divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by both, else return str(n).
medium.hint: Check divisibility by 15 first, then 3, then 5.

medium.question: Check Palindrome
medium.description: Given a string s, return True if it reads the same forwards and backwards, else False.

medium.question: Count Vowels
medium.description: Given a string s, return the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in it (case-insensitive).
medium.hint: Iterate over each char and check if it's in 'aeiouAEIOU'.

medium.question: Sum of List
medium.description: Given a list of integers nums, return their sum (without using sum()).
medium.hint: Loop through the list and keep a running total.

hard.question: Fibonacci Number
hard.description: Given a non-negative integer n, return the nth Fibonacci number. F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2).
hard.hint: Use iteration with two variables instead of recursion.

hard.question: Check Anagram
hard.description: Given two strings s1 and s2, return True if they are anagrams of each other (same characters, different order).
hard.hint: Two strings are anagrams if their sorted characters are equal.

hard.question: Remove Duplicates
hard.description: Given a list nums, return a new list with duplicates removed, preserving first occurrence order.
hard.hint: Use a 'seen' set and build a new list.

hard.question: Two Sum
hard.description: Given a list of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers that add up to target. You may assume exactly one solution exists.
hard.hint: Use a hash map to store seen values and their indices.

hard.question: Valid Parentheses
hard.description: Given a string s containing only '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', return True if the brackets are valid (properly opened and closed in order).
hard.hint: Use a stack. Push opening brackets, pop and match on closing brackets.

medium.hint: Use a loop multiplying from 2 to n.

medium.question: Check Leap Year
medium.description: Return 1 if year y is a leap year, else 0.
medium.hint: Divisible by 4 but not 100, OR divisible by 400.

medium.question: Power Function
medium.description: Return base raised to the power exp (non-negative).
medium.hint: Multiply base by itself exp times in a loop.

hard.question: GCD of Two Numbers
hard.description: Return the Greatest Common Divisor of a and b using Euclid's algorithm.
hard.hint: Use Euclid's algorithm: while(b != 0) { t=b; b=a%b; a=t; }

hard.hint: Extract digits with n%10 and build the reversed number.
